item.title: Inference Economics: Selling Intelligence
item.description: As AI spending hits $2.52 trillion annually, companies are discovering that the real cost isn't training, but inference. The shift from SaaS to inference economics is reshaping corporate budgets and transforming software pricing models.

item.title: Would You Trust AI To Manage Your Money?
item.description: OpenAI's Finances in ChatGPT puts a real-time financial analyst in your pocket. But between hallucinations, hidden fees, and zero fiduciary duty, is AI ready to manage your money?
